speaker: habakkuk
text: Violence!
name: Habakkuk

speaker: god
text: Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans— that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright— but the righteous will live by faith—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you— because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.
name: The LORD
